name: Proving Grounds: Trial of Adaptation
summary: A dynamic Muramite trial arena where the environment constantly shifts, forcing combatants to adapt to unpredictable hazards.
description: The Trial of Adaptation is a modular arena engineered to change its layout, hazards, and enemy composition in real time. Muramite overseers use Discord‑charged mechanisms to alter terrain, spawn constructs, and trigger environmental shifts. Combatants must adapt quickly to survive. Dragorn captives are forced into rapidly changing scenarios, while Muramite soldiers prove their versatility. Discord anomalies frequently destabilize the arena, creating chaotic and unpredictable conditions.
